verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at intel.com (HTTP 200), and an llms-full.txt exists that covers Core Ultra Series 2 (Lunar Lake) NPU capabilities, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented Intel docs. However, these are company-wide files, and the only cited product content is a one-line summary rather than 258V-specific technical detail. Missing for 10: product-specific agent-oriented docs for the Core Ultra 7 258V, evidence of the depth and structure of llms-full.txt content, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
